shippingPage.title: Shipping & payment
shippingPage.deliveryText: We deliver throughout Morocco and France. Delivery times are communicated when your order is confirmed.
shippingPage.paymentText: Cash on delivery (COD), bank transfer or WhatsApp order. Card payment (CMI) coming soon.
shippingPage.description: Delivery times and costs in Morocco, available payment methods.
shippingPage.feesText: Free delivery on orders over 1,500 MAD in Morocco. Below that, a flat 30 MAD fee.
shippingPage.delaysText: Casablanca & Rabat: 24-48h · Other Moroccan cities: 2-5 working days · France: 3-7 days.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.text: Your personal data (name, phone, address) is used only to process and deliver your orders. It is never sold or shared with third parties, except carriers required for delivery.
privacy.description: Our privacy policy and how we protect your data.
privacy.cookiesText: This site uses no advertising cookies. Only strictly necessary technical items may be stored locally to power the cart.
privacy.retentionText: Order data is kept for as long as needed to process and deliver, then archived for accounting purposes only.
privacy.rightsText: You can request access to, rectification or deletion of your data at any time by contacting us.
privacy.contactText: For any question about your data, contact us:
